predeclared_test: on a fix-preserving trial the structural predicate must report the pair DISTINGUISHABLE at every tick. A single collapse would falsify the account in MECHANISM_A.md.
structural_rule: D(nominal, gps_fault) = (LOW(nominal) sym-diff LOW(gps_fault)) intersect ACTIVE = {phys_gps} intersect ACTIVE
what_this_does_not_show: that self-occlusion occurs on ArduPilot 4.8. No fix-loss arm exists on that platform in this repository, and none was constructed.
why_not: self-occlusion requires a fault that REMOVES the GNSS fix. These 20 trials are fix-PRESERVING by their own validity criterion, so they cannot exhibit it. This is a negative control, not a replication.
